title: [Shortcut Guide] Fix tasklist buttons obscuring taskbar icons when taskbar is auto-hidden

proposed_comments.title: Document the entrance-animation parameter
proposed_comments.body:
### Document the entrance-animation parameter

**Severity:** `low`

The new `playEntrance` parameter controls whether each taskbar indicator plays its entrance animation, but its XML documentation is missing. Please document this parameter so the method contract explains why layout refreshes can disable animation.

```suggestion
        /// <param name="playEntrance">Whether to play the indicators' entrance animations.</param>
        /// <param name="monitor">The monitor whose taskbar buttons should be queried.</param>
```

confidence.rationale: The current upstream declaration adds the playEntrance parameter without a matching XML param tag, and the method uses it to control indicator entrance animation. The literal insertion is present in a clean candidate at the pinned upstream head; raw-blob EOL, XML-doc parsing, signature correspondence, and diff checks passed. The focused x64 Debug build was attempted but stopped in the unchanged Common.UI.Controls dependency because its generated MarkdownTextBlock PRI XML was missing. Round five was Lite after a full-agentic timeout, and the five-round cap is reached.
